rule.needed: accuracy drop >= 20% and paired bootstrap 95% lower bound of acc(control) - acc(cell) >= 10%
rule.doc:
Decision rule (fixed before any 27B run; jobs/d2/*.yaml): on items whose unedited read is right, a cell (family,
source, destination, layer set, DeltaNet mode) is NEEDED if accuracy drops >= 20 points and the paired bootstrap 95% lower bound
of acc(matched control) - acc(cell) is >= 10 points (control: lookup_off for lookup, binding_off for binding, same
destination, layers, mode); NOT NEEDED if the Wilson 95% lower bound of its accuracy is >= 90%; otherwise PARTIAL.
Positive control: each family's path sources at (after, all, mode absent) must be NEEDED, or that family is not
interpreted. Claims: C1a "RL breaks, RR survives" if RL (lookup, both, all) is NEEDED and RR (lookup, both, all) NOT
NEEDED; C1b "the answer site reads the lookup statement directly" if (lookup, final, all) is NEEDED for BL and RL and
(lookup, question, all) is not; "relay" if the reverse; the band where the lookup must be visible from the final
positions: the largest L with suf L NEEDED and the smallest L with pre L NEEDED.

rules.reader: a unit (query head, key/value group, layer, whole range; a code line or union of lines) is a reader if acc(control) - acc(unit) >= 10 points and its entity-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound >= 5 points (control: the same unit blocked from a statement of the same kind off the answer's path, the same items)
rules.relay: code: a line relays if blocking it together with the last tokens costs >= 10 points more than the last tokens alone (entity-cluster lower bound >= 5 points)
rules.explained: code: the lines explain the survivors if the union (last tokens + print + list/chain lines + the rest of the question) keeps answer org within 10 points of 'every line after the dict' (point estimate)
rules.readout: the best head is chosen on even-numbered scenes (pooled over the families that look the answer up) and scored on odd-numbered ones; it reads the pointer better than the slot probe if its entity-cluster lower bound > 39%
rules.reproduction: heads grid: memory → prompt with all late attention heads blocked at the last tokens reproduces batch 2 if its cluster interval overlaps 11%-20%
rules.multiplicity: single heads are many tests (24 heads x 4-8 layers per range): a single-head reader is read together with its key/value group and layer cells, never alone

claims.intervals: Headline and rule intervals: entity-cluster bootstrap (the queried entities resampled with replacement within each domain, all their items kept; 4000 draws, seed 0); reported second: the item-level Wilson interval (accuracy) and the paired item bootstrap (2000 draws). Every number also per domain, with n items / k entities.
